entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I'm calling because I need to return something. I bought a helmet a little while ago, and I just... I can't keep it.
I'm sorry to hear that, but I can certainly look into the return for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, there's nothing wrong with it, it's a great helmet. It's just... the color. I really thought it would be a different shade, and it just doesn't look right. The box is still unopened, I never even took it out.
I see. Getting the right color is definitely important. Let me pull up your account. Could I get your email address, please?
Sure, it's sam.jones@email.com. I've been a customer for a long time, and I was just so disappointed when I saw it. I really needed this money back for some other things.
Thank you, Sam. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered about 53 days ago. Let me just check our policy.
Okay... I hope it's not too late.

Not at all! You're well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely approve this return for you. We want to ensure you have the right gear for your safety, and if that means getting a different helmet, we support that.
Oh, wow! That's such a relief. Thank you so much, Charlie. I was so worried. You've really helped me out.

It's my pleasure, Sam. I'm emailing you a prepaid return label right now. Just attach that to the box and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Have a great day and ride safe!
